summary: Full-stack testing of GLP-1 Care Platform (Verdia). Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passed (public content, contact/newsletter, auth 401 handling, patient/doctor/admin role-based flows, AI assessment via Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: Landing, Doctors, Pricing, Program detail, Blog (with category filter), Support/Contact, AI Assessment, and all three role-based dashboards (patient, doctor, admin) render and function correctly. Green/sage healthcare palette confirmed; no purple/violet gradients. Role enforcement (patient blocked from /admin) working via ProtectedRoute.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 450-line file mixing auth, public content, patient/doctor/admin, and AI. Consider splitting into routers/modules (auth.py, patient.py, admin.py, ai.py, seed.py) for maintainability once product scope grows.

AuthContext calls /api/auth/me on every mount and logs 401 to console for unauthenticated visitors. Minor: suppress or downgrade the log (already caught, but the network 401 still appears in devtools).

PatientDashboard MetricCard renders delta='0.0 kg' as an amber 'up' badge when only one check-in exists (weightDelta computed from first==latest). Consider hiding the delta badge until >=2 metrics exist.
doctor_dashboard endpoint falls back to showing all appointments to any doctor for demo — clearly labeled but should be gated behind an env flag before production.
admin_stats uses `await db.list_collection_names()` on every request just to conditionally count `orders`. Small perf nit; simply always count and default to 0.
Cookie is set with SameSite=None + Secure — correct for cross-site preview domain. Good.
All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes matching the spec; testability is excellent.
test_credentials: No pre-seeded credentials; auth is via Emergent OAuth. For auth-gated tests I inserted temporary users + sessions directly into MongoDB (users, user_sessions collections) and passed them as Cookie session_token. All test users prefixed user_UITEST_/user_TEST_ and cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Seed runs automatically on backend startup (6 doctors, 4 programs, 3 plans, 4 testimonials, 6 blog posts, 6 FAQs, platform_stats). Verified seed count via GET endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. authenticated flows (creates temp sessions in MongoDB, cleans up via fixtures). To test dashboards in the browser, inject a session_token cookie for the preview domain (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None) tied to a user row in `users` (roles: patient/doctor/admin) plus a `user_sessions` row. AI assessment endpoint is live and returns Claude Sonnet 4.5 replies (~5–10s latency).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
